INVARIANTS
- Whisper large-v3 (~4.3 GB) is ALWAYS resident.
- At most ONE LLM engine resident (32 GB budget).
- Engine switch = full teardown + reload
(vLLM-sleep avoided: CuMem conflict on Blackwell).
